name: antasphere
description: The participant and coach skills of the Antasphere Hackathon, every one prefixed hackathon-: hackathon-setup (from zero to your team's app running, the machine checked first), hackathon-doctor (the opening of every session: the clock, the doctor, the push received, the project description, the pacing), the three decks from the organizers' Slideless templates, each hosted with a share link and registered on the platform: hackathon-deck-demo (episodes of Playwright screenshots), hackathon-deck-pitch (the stage) and hackathon-deck-vote (the elevator pitch the other participants read), and for coaches hackathon-coach-brief (a team's chat, requests, decks and repository, summarized) and hackathon-coach-help (answer a help request, post on your word).
